title: CircuitryOrchestration
description: JSON Schema for Circuitry orchestration YAML files (DOL — Domain Object Language).

adapter.description: Adapter to use for model invocations. Options: ollama, openai, anthropic, litellm. Optional — can be set in config.json.

model.description: Model identifier. Optional — can be set in config.json.

flow.description: Top-level flow for the implicit root dynamic. Defaults to chain.

effects.description: Ordered list of top-level effects to execute.

interface.description: Declares typed inputs and outputs for this orchestration. Used by `use` effects for validation and auto-wiring.

inputs.description: Input declarations. Keys are state variable names.

type.description: Expected type: string, number, boolean, array, object.

required.description: Whether this input is required. Default false.

outputs.description: Output declarations. Keys are output names exposed to the parent.

type.description: Output type: string, number, boolean, array, object.

allOf.description: Names must start with a letter or underscore, followed by letters, digits, or underscores. No spaces or dots.
Names matching iter_<N> are reserved for loop iteration segments.

FlowModel.description: Execution topology. chain/chain_of_thought/cot = sequential (each effect sees prior outputs). tree/tree_of_thought/tot = parallel (all effects see input snapshot).

OnErrorDefault.description: Error handling policy. fail = abort; skip = omit this effect and continue; continue = record error and continue.

OnErrorLoop.description: Loop-specific error policy. fail = abort; break = exit loop; continue = skip iteration and continue.

ConditionDef.description: Condition definition for if/conditional and while loop.

mode.description: model = LLM evaluates template and returns boolean. cel = CEL expression evaluated against state.

template.description: Prompt template for model-based evaluation. Enforced as required when mode is model.

expr.description: CEL expression for deterministic evaluation. Must use state.prime.<name>.value prefix. Enforced as required when mode is cel.

kind.description: Asset type, e.g. image, file, audio.

EffectDef.description: A single executable effect. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

type.description: Unknown effect type. Must be one of: prompt, dynamic, if, conditional, loop, reflector, tool, use.

PromptEffect.description: Atomic model invocation. Produces a typed value at prime.<name>.value.

prompt_type.description: Output type. Defaults to text. Use json when output needs to be an array or object used by downstream effects.

schema.description: JSON Schema for validating structured output. Enforced as required when prompt_type is json, object, or array.

template.description: Mustache template string. Use {{key}} for initial state, {{prime.name.value}} for effect outputs.

messages.description: Role-based message array. Mutually exclusive with template.

deterministic.description: If true, use temperature=0 or equivalent.

inputs.description: Prompt-local key/value pairs available in template rendering.

DynamicEffect.description: Named container that executes child effects as a chain or tree. Outputs at prime.<name>.<child_name>.value.

effects.description: Child effects to execute. Must be non-empty.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum parallel executions for tree flow.

ConditionalEffect.description: Evaluates a condition and executes exactly one branch. Name is optional — named conditionals record decision metadata.

then.description: Effects to execute when condition is true.

else.description: Effects to execute when condition is false. Use the same inner effect names as then for deterministic state paths.

threshold.description: Confidence threshold for model-based evaluation. Default 0.5.

LoopEffect.description: Iterates over a collection (each) or repeats while a condition holds (while). Name is optional.

collect.description: Name of a body effect whose .value is aggregated across all iterations into an array. Written to prime.<loop_name>.collected.value after the loop completes. Requires a named loop.

flow.description: Execution topology for each-loops. chain (default) = sequential. tree = all iterations run in parallel via ThreadPoolExecutor. while-loops always run sequentially.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum parallel workers when flow is tree. Default: unbounded.

each.description: Collection iteration config. each.in must point to a prompt_type: json effect whose output is an array.

in.description: Dot-delimited state path resolving to a JSON array, e.g. prime.my_prompt.value.

as.description: Variable name for the current element. Defaults to 'item'. Accessible in body as {{as_name}}.

while.description: Continuation condition. Loop repeats while condition is true.

min_iterations.description: Minimum iterations before condition is checked.

ReflectorEffect.description: Planning-time effect. Reads state, generates a Dynamic plan, executes it. Repeats for max_iterations cycles.

effects.description: Inner effects template used as the base dynamic per planning cycle.

plan_from_step.description: Name of the inner effect whose output drives the reflector plan. Default: propose_steps.

generated_key.description: State key under which generated effects are recorded. Default: generated.

stop_on_done.description: Stop when the plan signals completion. Default true.

max_effects.description: Maximum effects the reflector can generate per cycle. Default 8. Alias: max_steps.

prime_template.description: Custom prime template for reflector planning. Overrides the built-in REFLECTOR_PRIME_V1.

ToolEffect.description: Executes a non-LLM side-effect via a named plugin. Writes result at prime.<name>.value.

prompt.description: Primary prompt/input text for the plugin. Supports Mustache rendering. For comfyui: the image generation prompt.

model.description: Model or checkpoint name for the plugin. For comfyui: checkpoint filename (e.g. flux1-schnell-fp8.safetensors).

params.description: Plugin-specific parameters. All string values support Mustache rendering against current state. Takes precedence over top-level prompt/model.

UseEffect.description: Runs another orchestration as an isolated sub-step. Provide 'orchestration' (name/path) or 'inline' (Mustache template yielding YAML). State is fully isolated.

orchestration.description: Orchestration reference: a bundled name (e.g. 'article-summarizer') or a file path. Mutually exclusive with 'inline'.

inline.description: Mustache template that renders to orchestration YAML at runtime. Typically references a prior prompt output (e.g. '{{prime.plan.value}}'). Mutually exclusive with 'orchestration'.

validate.description: Validate inline YAML against the orchestration schema before execution. Default true. Set false to skip validation for LLM-generated YAML that may use loose formatting.

inputs.description: Input mapping. Keys become top-level state keys in the child orchestration. String values are Mustache-rendered against parent state.

outputs.description: Output mapping. Keys become fields in this effect's .value. Values are dot-paths into the child's final state (e.g. 'prime.summarize.value').
